intro: LA has the densest airspace in the country — five towered fields inside twenty miles, helicopters everywhere, and the SoCal TRACON stitching it together. The amateur scene is also unusually strong, with big linked repeater systems on Mount Wilson and Santiago Peak covering the whole basin from a single hilltop.
introz: 洛杉矶的空域密度全美第一——二十英里内五个有塔机场、满天直升机，由南加进场管制统一编织。业余无线电氛围也异常浓厚，威尔逊山和圣地亚哥峰上的大型链接中继系统，从一个山头就能覆盖整个盆地。

stations.d: LAX runs its two runway complexes on separate tower frequencies. Best listening is from the In-N-Out on Sepulveda or Clutter's Park.
stations.dz: 洛杉矶机场两组跑道使用不同塔台频率。Sepulveda 路上的 In-N-Out 或 Clutter's Park 是最佳收听点。

stations.d: One of the busiest radar facilities in the world. Sectors are reassigned constantly — sweep 124–128 MHz to find live ones.
stations.dz: 全球最繁忙的雷达管制单位之一。扇区频繁调整——在 124–128 MHz 扫一遍找当前在用的。

stations.d: Historically the busiest general-aviation airport in the world. Flight schools, news helicopters, firefighting aircraft and celebrity jets on the same frequency.
stations.dz: 历史上全球最繁忙的通航机场。飞行学校、新闻直升机、消防飞机和名人私人机全挤在同一频率。

stations.d: Short runways in a bowl surrounded by hills. Approaches are dramatic to listen to.
stations.dz: 被山丘环绕的盆地里的短跑道，进近过程听起来很有戏剧性。

stations.d: Famous for its noise-abatement departure — full power then a sharp thrust cutback. Audible in the radio calls.
stations.dz: 以降噪离场程序闻名——全推力后急剧收油。在通话里能听出来。

stations.z: 卡塔利娜“空中机场”公共频率
stations.d: A mesa-top runway on an island. Pilots self-announce; hearing an approach here is a treat.
stations.dz: 岛上台地顶端的跑道。飞行员自主通报，能听到一次进近很过瘾。

stations.d: A famously unmoderated simplex frequency that has been a fixture of LA radio culture for decades. Sometimes technical, sometimes chaos. Listen before you judge.
stations.dz: 一个著名的无人管理直通频率，几十年来一直是洛杉矶无线电文化的一部分。有时很技术，有时很混乱。先听再评价。

stations.d: From Mount Wilson, Mount Baldy or Angeles Crest this reaches the entire basin.
stations.dz: 在威尔逊山、Baldy 山或 Angeles Crest 公路上，可覆盖整个盆地。

stations.d: Mount Wilson hosts an extraordinary density of repeaters. Use the VX-6's band scan up there and you will find dozens.
stations.dz: 威尔逊山上中继密度极高。在山上用 VX-6 的波段扫描，能找到几十个。

stations.d: Southern California has one of the last genuinely active 1.25 m communities. Your VX-6 transmits there, which most handhelds cannot.
stations.dz: 南加州是 1.25 米波段最后一批真正活跃的地区之一。VX-6 能在此发射，多数手台做不到。

stations.z: 加州公路巡警洛杉矶分局（低波段）
stations.d: Analog low band, receivable and often the only real-time traffic source in a canyon. Scan 39.2–39.9 MHz.
stations.dz: 模拟低波段，可以收到，在峡谷里往往是唯一的实时路况来源。扫 39.2–39.9 MHz。

stations.z: Angeles 国家森林 / CAL FIRE
stations.d: The San Gabriels burn regularly. Federal and state fire nets in 151–173 MHz stay analog and are the most compelling listening in the region during a fire.
stations.dz: 圣盖博山经常起火。151–173 MHz 的联邦与州消防网仍是模拟制式，火灾期间是本区最值得听的内容。

stations.d: Air-tanker and helitanker coordination over the foothills.
stations.dz: 山麓上空灭火机与直升机的协调。

stations.z: 洛杉矶警局 / 消防局 · 集群
stations.d: LA-area agencies are on 800 MHz trunked systems. Some talkgroups have historically been analog and technically receivable, but following a trunked system on a VX-6 is impractical and much of it is now digital. Treat as out of scope.
stations.dz: 洛杉矶地区各机构使用 800 MHz 集群系统。历史上部分通话组是模拟的、理论上可收，但用 VX-6 跟踪集群系统不现实，且大部分已数字化。视为超出范围。

stations.z: 洛杉矶 / 长滩船舶交通管理
stations.d: The largest container complex in North America. Constant pilot and tug traffic.
stations.dz: 北美最大的集装箱港区，引航员和拖轮通话不断。

stations.d: Scan 160.215–161.565 near any mainline. The BNSF Transcon through Cajon Pass is one of the great railfan listening spots in America.
stations.dz: 在任何干线附近扫 160.215–161.565。穿越 Cajon 山口的 BNSF 横贯线是全美最棒的铁路收听地点之一。

stations.d: Public radio with a legendary music department. Morning Becomes Eclectic has broken more artists than most labels.
stations.dz: 拥有传奇音乐部门的公共电台。Morning Becomes Eclectic 节目捧红的乐手比很多唱片公司都多。

stations.z: KXLU 罗耀拉玛利蒙特大学
stations.d: Student freeform since 1959. Punk, experimental, Latin — completely uncommercial.
stations.dz: 1959 年至今的学生自由形式电台。朋克、实验、拉丁——完全非商业。

stations.z: KPFK 洛杉矶 Pacifica 台
stations.d: 112 kW from Mount Wilson — one of the most powerful non-commercial signals in the country.
stations.dz: 威尔逊山 112 千瓦发射——全美功率最大的非商业信号之一。

stations.d: A commercial station, but historically important enough to be worth a listen.
stations.dz: 虽是商业台，但历史地位足够重要，值得一听。

stations.z: MURS · 主题公园与活动作业
stations.d: Film shoots, theme parks, marathons and festivals lean heavily on MURS and FRS. Scan those channels near any production.
stations.dz: 影视拍摄、主题公园、马拉松和音乐节大量使用 MURS 与 FRS。在任何拍摄现场附近扫这些频道。
